title: Scored on what the user sees, the gain halves
desc: Slopegraph on the same 201 test photos, y-axis 60 to 95 percent. Before (G0: flat, no language head): 67.7% on the first guess, 83.6% right card among the 3 shown (top-3). What shipped (G0h: flat plus language head): 77.6% first guess, 89.1% among the 3 shown. The gap is 9.95 points on the first guess and 5.47 points among the 3 shown: the gain roughly halves.
